field_mapping.assistant_NEXT_CHAT: exact msg_created assistant content through original ws.broadcast → process_visible_message_event; initial synthetic SQL row mimics saved message
field_mapping.clock: epoch seconds → original local datetime formatting; TZ Asia/Shanghai fixed
field_mapping.poll: original _tick manually invoked at +30,+60,+90,+120 seconds; original background thread not launched
field_mapping.two_claims: original _fire_monitor invoked twice on same captured schedule row after original normal fire; original DELETE+rowcount refuses duplicate
field_mapping.user_return: synthetic saved user msg_created through original ws.broadcast; original hook removes pending proactive plans
field_mapping.disable: original set_proactive_enabled boolean; save_settings only writes fake synthetic dict; pending timer remains
field_mapping.session_switch: insert synthetic newer conv-B; original _fire_monitor selects latest conversations row
field_mapping.fresh_process: two real OS child processes, same isolated SQLite; no transferred timer object
field_mapping.generation_control: original current_generation/generation_event; no generation scope created by selected background caller
field_mapping.memory_surfacing: context-only DTO with no timer; true producer not executed, inconclusive
field_mapping.idle: separate original autonomy_actor_configs, minimum5min; not silently mapped to2min NEXT_CHAT or same toggle
